name: project-monitor
description: Monitor local project commands, terminal output, and captured errors from one desktop workspace.

scripts.dev:electron: wait-on dist-electron/main.js dist-electron/preload.js && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5273 electronmon .
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main && npm run build:preload
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.mac.yml --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.win.yml --publish never
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.linux.yml --publish never
scripts.publish:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.mac.yml --publish always
scripts.publish:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.win.yml --publish always
scripts.publish:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.linux.yml --publish always
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
